messages:
Rohan: Heads-up — we're at T-4h before the cutoff for v1.8.2-rc. If you need an exception, post the reason + PR link now. Exceptions need an approver and a short test/canary plan. :alarm_clock:

Maya: Quick one — docs-only fix in PR #8912. tiny typo. Is that eligible for a docs fast-track?

Samir: Docs-only generally OK if changelog entry is present and CI is green. Maya, add a changelog line under Unreleased -> 1.8.2-rc and ping me. :thumbsup:

Tess: There's a build-tools deps bump in PR #8920 (bazel rules). Unit tests flaked but patch fixes it. Requesting late-merge to include updated rules in rc3.

Rohan: For infra/deps changes we require a canary + rollback plan. Please include smoke steps and an estimated risk level in the PR.

Tess: Canary plan added to PR: deploy to staging, run `./scripts/smoke.sh --suite=runtime`, check error rates for 15m. Rollback command: `git revert -m 1 <merge-commit>` + redeploy. Risk: low-medium. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/8920

Samir: @Tess please add a 3-line canary checklist in the PR and tag me for approval. Oncall will own rollback.

ci-cd-bot: alert: RC freeze scheduled at 2026-03-17T12:00Z. Exception requests submitted after cutoff will be auto-denied.

Ana: Tiny heads-up — changelog owner for infra is Kev, I think he's OOO until noon.

Kev: Here — can take the changelog and do a quick review. If you add the snippet I'll stamp it.

Maya: Added changelog snippet to PR #8912 (docs).

Tess: Added canary checklist, smoke passed in staging at 11:02Z. Requesting exception for deps bump.

Samir: Approving the deps exception conditional on a final canary smoke at 11:45Z and green CI. If any flakiness shows up we defer to the next patch window.

Rohan: Noted. If approved I'll merge at 11:50 and tag rc3. Post-merge monitoring for 30m by whoever touched the PRs — watch error rates and latency. :eyes:

Maya: Quick Q — is this a patch bump or minor bump? It's bugfix/docs.

Samir: Patch bump. Release tag will be v1.8.2-rc3.

Tess: Thanks — standing by for merge and watching canary metrics.

Kev: Stamped changelog. :white_check_mark:

ci-cd-bot: deploy: canary started for v1.8.2-rc3 at 2026-03-17T11:50Z. Links: https://deploys.redwood/in/1234

Rohan: Closing the thread — anything else, escalate in #eng-oncall. Good coordination, team. :tada:
